plugins.name: oss-branch-protection
plugins.description: Apply a consistent branch-protection template across all public repos in a GitHub org — admin-exempt (maintainer keeps direct-commit/force-push), CI-gated merges for contributors, force-push/deletion blocked. Idempotent applier that derives each repo's required CI check automatically.

plugins.name: signalk-plugin
plugins.description: Author and publish a SignalK server plugin — the @signalk/server-api patterns that work (resource provider vs router, deltas, position), the ESM scaffold, TypeBox config schemas, the no-install-scripts rule (app store uses --ignore-scripts; containerize heavy parts), storage locations (config vs data dir vs applicationData — never node_modules), and OIDC trusted publishing.

plugins.name: signalk-container-helper
plugins.description: Build a SignalK plugin that runs a Docker/Podman container via the signalk-container manager — the signalk-container-helper library packages the lifecycle (start, HTTP readiness, updates, clean stop) and the shared React config-panel components.

plugins.name: signalk-registry
plugins.description: Preview your expected SignalK registry score before publishing — screenshots, changelog, and audit gaps that cost points, with the score you'd likely receive.

plugins.name: npm-oidc-publish
plugins.description: Publish an npm package from GitHub Actions via OIDC trusted publishing — no NPM_TOKEN, no OTP in CI; the new-package first-publish flow and the registry-propagation 404 gotcha.

plugins.name: debug-mcp-agent
plugins.description: Debug an MCP / tool-backed AI agent: probe ground truth before trusting the agent's account of itself (404-vs-error, which-model, server-down vs missing-data, auth-vs-absence).

plugins.name: record-web-gif
plugins.description: Record a running web app (dev server or live URL) to a clean GIF for a README/PR/demo — puppeteer-core + system Chrome + ffmpeg, with the headless WebGL/canvas blank-frame gotcha handled.

plugins.name: signalk-e2e
plugins.description: Browser-level end-to-end testing before you open the PR — two co-installed skills: webapp-e2e drives any web app (dev server, live URL, isolated Module-Federation component) with the repo's bundled Playwright chromium; signalk-server-e2e adds the SignalK-specific harness (scratch-config server spin-up, WebSocket delta feed, the Freeboard-SK chart recipe). Both handle the headless blank-canvas gotcha and gate the change on a green run attached as PR evidence.
